raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
# PR type
- [x] Bug Fix
- [ ] New Feature
- [ ] Document Updates
- [ ] More Models or Datasets Support

# PR information

Fixes #10410

## Problem

GRPO on a multimodal model with `--use_liger_kernel true` and `--deepspeed zero3` hangs in the first training step when the ranks hold a mix of text-only and image samples. Nothing is raised; with the default `ddp_timeout` the job just stays blocked.

## Root cause

The Liger path in `compute_loss` goes through `_forward_redirection`, so the DeepSpeed engine runs the template's pre-forward hook first. For multimodal templates the hook (`Template.pre_forward_hook` -> `_post_encode`) replaces `input_ids`/`pixel_values` with `inputs_embeds`, and text-only samples run the vision encoder on a dummy image, so every rank calls the vision encoder once.

The redirected callable was `lambda *_, **__: self.compute_liger_loss(unwrapped_model, model_inputs, grpo_batch)`. It drops the hook's kwargs, and `_get_last_hidden_state` then calls the inner model with the original `model_inputs`, which still contain `pixel_values`. Ranks holding images run the vision encoder a second time, the ranks issue different ZeRO-3 parameter all-gathers, and training deadlocks. Without ZeRO-3 it does not hang, but image samples still pay for a second vision-encoder pass.

This form came from #9406 (the `KeyError: 'input_ids'` fix) and is unchanged on `main`.

## Change

Only `swift/rlhf_trainers/grpo_trainer.py` changes (+16/-3), plus one CPU test.

- `compute_loss` (Liger path): the redirected function now receives the hook's kwargs. When they contain `inputs_embeds`, it passes them to `compute_liger_loss` together with the original `input_ids`, which is still needed to select the completion tokens. Otherwise (text-only models, or templates whose `_post_encode` does not produce `inputs_embeds`) it keeps the previous behavior.
- `_get_last_hidden_state` (multimodal branch): drops `input_ids` when `inputs_embeds` is present, since the model accepts only one of them.

`_forward_redirection` is kept, so ZeRO-3 still gathers the backbone and `lm_head` parameters inside the engine's forward. After the change the inner model gets the same kwargs as the non-Liger path (`model(**inputs)` through the same hook).

## Experiment results

The run that hung, repeated with the fix. Qwen3.8-27B (model_type `qwen3_5`, template `qwen3_8`), LoRA rank 128, 4 training GPUs (H100, ZeRO-3 + Liger) and a `swift rollout` server (vLLM, TP4), async generation, 16K max length. Each step mixes 8 text-only prompts and 8 prompts with 2 images (64 completions).

| ms-swift | Result | Peak training memory |
| --- | --- | ---: |
| 4.5.3 | Hangs in step 1 (twice). With `--ddp_timeout 7200`, all ranks abort at the same `_ALLGATHER_BASE` (SeqNum 76799): ranks 1 and 3 on the vision `patch_embed` weight (442,368 -> 1,769,472 elements), ranks 0 and 2 on a 24-byte object gather | - |
| `main` (5c7f3ae) + this PR | 3/3 steps completed | 44.25 GiB |

The second row installs a wheel built from this branch, with no other patch. Environment: PyTorch 2.11, Transformers 5.13.0, DeepSpeed 0.18.9, vLLM 0.24.0, Liger Kernel 0.8.2.

CPU regression test:

```bash
python -m unittest tests/train/test_grpo_liger_mllm_forward.py
# Ran 1 test ... OK (2 subtests: with and without an image)
pytest tests/train/test_grpo_liger_mllm_forward.py tests/train/test_grpo_reward_metrics.py -q
# 5 passed, 2 subtests passed
pre-commit run --files swift/rlhf_trainers/grpo_trainer.py tests/train/test_grpo_liger_mllm_forward.py
# all hooks passed
```

`tests/train/test_grpo_liger_mllm_forward.py` calls the real `GRPOTrainer.compute_loss`, `_ForwardRedirection`, `_get_last_hidden_state` and `Template.pre_forward_hook` with a toy multimodal model whose `_post_encode` follows `Qwen2VLTemplate` (dummy image for text-only samples). It checks that the vision encoder runs once per forward with and without an image, and that the inner model receives `inputs_embeds` only. On `main` both cases fail (the image case calls the vision encoder twice). It is a `unittest.TestCase`, so `tests/run.py` picks it up; it runs on CPU in a few seconds.

Not tested: FSDP, sequence parallel, eval-time Liger loss, and models other than Qwen3.8-27B on GPU.

Scope:

- Covered: templates whose `_post_encode` produces `inputs_embeds`, such as Qwen2-VL / Qwen2.5-VL / Qwen3.5 through `Qwen2VLTemplate._post_encode`.
- Not covered: `Qwen3VLTemplate._post_encode` returns the inputs unchanged, so Qwen3-VL keeps the previous behavior, and its vision encoder still runs only on the ranks with images (on the non-Liger path as well).
- Not changed: `gkd_trainer.py` uses the same `lambda *_, **__:` pattern for its Liger loss (student and teacher). I did not touch it because I have not tested multimodal GKD.

This PR was prepared with AI assistance (Claude). I reviewed every changed line and ran the experiments above.

# Checklist

- [x] I have linked the related issue above, if there is one.
- [x] I have reviewed and understand every changed line, and I can explain how the change works and why it is correct.
- [x] I have run the relevant tests or reproductions locally, and included the commands and results above (if applicable).
- [x] I am responsible for the content of this PR, regardless of how it was produced.

+                # For multimodal models, the template's pre-forward hook has already turned `input_ids` and
+                # `pixel_values` into `inputs_embeds`, running the vision encoder once on every rank (with a

+                return self.compute_liger_loss(unwrapped_model, model_inputs, grpo_batch)

@@ -0,0 +1,146 @@
+# Copyright (c) ModelScope Contributors. All rights reserved.
+"""The multimodal Liger GRPO loss must call the vision encoder the same number of times on every rank.
+
+Under ZeRO-3 the ranks all-gather parameters module by module, so a rank holding an image sample that runs
+the vision encoder one extra time desyncs the collectives and hangs training on mixed text/image data.
+"""
+import torch
+import unittest
+from torch import nn
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+from swift.rlhf_trainers.grpo_trainer import GRPOTrainer
+from swift.rlhf_trainers.utils import _ForwardRedirection
+from swift.template.base import Template
+
+HIDDEN = 4
+
+
+class CountingVisual(nn.Module):
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.proj = nn.Linear(HIDDEN, HIDDEN)
+        self.calls = 0
+
+    def forward(self, pixel_values):
+        self.calls += 1
+        return self.proj(pixel_values)
+
+
+class InnerModel(nn.Module):
+    """Mimics a HF multimodal backbone: it runs the vision encoder itself when given `pixel_values`."""
+
+    def __init__(self, visual):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.embed_tokens = nn.Embedding(16, HIDDEN)
+        self.visual = visual
+        self.received = None
+
+    def forward(self, input_ids=None, inputs_embeds=None, pixel_values=None, attention_mask=None):
+        self.received = {'input_ids': input_ids, 'inputs_embeds': inputs_embeds, 'pixel_values': pixel_values}
+        if (input_ids is None) == (inputs_embeds is None):
+            raise ValueError('You must specify exactly one of input_ids or inputs_embeds')
+        if inputs_embeds is None:
+            inputs_embeds = self.embed_tokens(input_ids)
+            if pixel_values is not None:
+                inputs_embeds = inputs_embeds + self.visual(pixel_values).mean()
+        return SimpleNamespace(last_hidden_state=inputs_embeds)
+
+
+class MultimodalModel(nn.Module):
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.visual = CountingVisual()
+        self.model = InnerModel(self.visual)
+        self.lm_head = nn.Linear(HIDDEN, 16)
+
+    @property
+    def device(self):
+        return torch.device('cpu')
+
+    def forward(self, input_ids=None, inputs_embeds=None, pixel_values=None, attention_mask=None):
+        raise AssertionError('replaced by _forward_redirection')
+
+
+class DummyImageTemplate(Template):
+    """`_post_encode` in the style of `Qwen2VLTemplate._get_inputs_embeds_hf`: text-only samples go through the
+    vision encoder with a dummy image, so every rank calls it once per forward."""
+
+    def _post_encode(self, model, inputs):
+        inputs_embeds = model.model.embed_tokens(inputs['input_ids'])
+        pixel_values = inputs.get('pixel_values')
+        if pixel_values is None:
+            inputs_embeds = inputs_embeds + model.visual(torch.zeros(1, HIDDEN)).mean() * 0.
+        else:
+            inputs_embeds = inputs_embeds + model.visual(pixel_values).mean()
+        return {'inputs_embeds': inputs_embeds}
+
+
+class Engine(nn.Module):
+    """Stands in for the DeepSpeed engine that `_forward_redirection` routes the call through."""
+
+    def __init__(self, module):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.module = module
+
+    def forward(self, *args, **kwargs):
+        return self.module(*args, **kwargs)
+
+
+def make_trainer(model):
+    template = DummyImageTemplate.__new__(DummyImageTemplate)
+    template.mode = 'rlhf'
+    # The same registration as `Template.register_post_encode_hook`.
+    model.register_forward_pre_hook(template.pre_forward_hook, with_kwargs=True)
+
+    trainer = object.__new__(GRPOTrainer)
+    trainer.model = Engine(model)
+    trainer.accelerator = SimpleNamespace(unwrap_model=lambda wrapped: wrapped.module, is_main_process=True)
+    trainer.args = SimpleNamespace(report_to=[])
+    trainer._forward_redirection = _ForwardRedirection()
+    trainer.use_liger_loss = True
+    trainer.is_multimodal = True
+    trainer.chord_sft_iterator = None
+    trainer.model_kwarg_keys = []
+    trainer.liger_inputs = []
+
+    def compute_liger_loss(unwrapped_model, model_inputs, grpo_batch):
+        trainer.liger_inputs.append(model_inputs)
+        # `compute_liger_loss` selects the completion tokens from `input_ids`.
+        assert model_inputs['input_ids'] is not None
+        return trainer._get_last_hidden_state(unwrapped_model, model_inputs, logits_to_keep=1).sum()
+
+    trainer.compute_liger_loss = compute_liger_loss
+    return trainer
+
+
+class TestGRPOLigerMultimodalForward(unittest.TestCase):
+
+    def test_liger_loss_runs_the_vision_encoder_once_per_forward(self):
+        for with_image in (False, True):
+            with self.subTest(with_image=with_image):
+                model = MultimodalModel()
+                trainer = make_trainer(model)
+                model_inputs = {
+                    'input_ids': torch.tensor([[1, 2, 3]]),
+                    'attention_mask': torch.ones(1, 3, dtype=torch.long)
+                }
+                if with_image:
+                    model_inputs['pixel_values'] = torch.ones(2, HIDDEN)
+
+                loss = trainer.compute_loss(trainer.model, {'model_inputs': model_inputs, 'grpo_batch': None})
+
+                self.assertTrue(torch.is_tensor(loss))
+                # The same count with and without an image keeps the ZeRO-3 all-gathers aligned across ranks.
+                self.assertEqual(model.visual.calls, 1)
+                received = model.model.received
+                self.assertIsNotNone(received['inputs_embeds'])
+                self.assertIsNone(received['input_ids'])
+                self.assertIsNone(received['pixel_values'])
+                self.assertTrue(torch.equal(trainer.liger_inputs[0]['input_ids'], model_inputs['input_ids']))
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    unittest.main()
